scope: Exactly 20 most selected main, core, and accessory names in a fixed synthetic sample; warmups are excluded from the ranking.
limitations: These counts describe a synthetic sample. They do not describe owner or athlete usage.
Each equipment list states all requirements for one library version. The list does not encode alternatives.
Other combines distinct items. Availability of a box does not imply availability of a bench, rack, trap bar, or TRX straps.
Unnamed loads use explicit library choices. A different version needs a separate entry or a richer equipment model.
The shoulder-rotation warmup uses the band option. Its text still permits a cable option.
Trap bar deadlift uses other. It does not require a separate straight barbell.
A wall is an ordinary surface, not equipment in this eval. Wall ankle mobility requires bodyweight only.
